methodology.eventTime: max(snapshot capture time, exchange option source time)
methodology.windows: non-overlapping forward windows of 72 completed 5m bars
methodology.lookahead: the first price bar begins strictly after the GEX event timestamp
methodology.gexSign: calls positive and puts negative; dealer-position sign is assumed, not observed
methodology.linearTest: GEX conditions a shared-equity dual aggregation strategy; no options are traded
methodology.optionTest: not run because snapshots lack point-in-time option bid/ask, IV, theta and executable hedge fills
